capabilities: Play local MP3 files from a chosen vault folder
Run a Pomodoro timer with customizable work and break durations
Control playback and timer from the status bar or command palette
extras: Online streams require an internet connection and work out of the box; local playback works offline but only supports MP3 files. Stream mode shows only play/pause controls, not previous/next.
problem: Staying focused usually means leaving Obsidian for a music player and a separate Pomodoro timer; this keeps both inside the vault.
summary: Audio plugin that streams lofi radio or plays local MP3s from a vault folder alongside a built-in Pomodoro focus timer.
